failure_sequence: round 8 edited src/moon_phase.cpp and was rolled back after a new compile diagnostic
round 9 received that candidate-rejection diagnostic but was authorized to edit src/ink_renderer.cpp
the model could not repair the rejected moon_phase candidate because the feedback target was outside its write scope

round_8.final_request_context: Included the exact read-only moon_phase.hpp API and forced edit_file for only src/moon_phase.cpp.

round_9.final_request_context: Carried the prior candidate_rejection_errors while forcing edit_file for only src/ink_renderer.cpp.

dynamic_evidence.live_progress_before_terminal: Production target rotation worked and accepted rounds reduced failures 6->5->3, proving the prior r36 mutation-collapse defect closed.

root_cause.summary: Factory persisted candidate rejection diagnostics but not the rejected candidate's repair_target_files. The next behavioral round independently advanced the production-frontier cursor, so diagnostic feedback and mutation authority described different files.
root_cause.first_causal_boundary: workspace quality repair round-state projection between candidate rollback and the next LLM repair request

fix.behavior: When a candidate is rejected for source compile or verifier regression, persist its exact repair_target_files and pin the next repair round to the rejected target inside the same scoped authorized candidate set. Clear the pin only after a real subsequent write. Equal-count swaps remain free to rotate because they do not identify a target-local regression.

verification.tdd_red: With a rejection for src/moon_phase.cpp and a rotation cursor pointing elsewhere, the implementation selected src/main.cpp.

live_validation.result: After round 2 rejected src/diary/diary_book.cpp, rounds 3 and 4 remained on the same target. Exact final requests 13ba2ca2d05f39f4c80c2348 and f9a61c81c0eb01d58dc39a18 projected candidate_rejection_target_pinned=true. The former feedback/target mismatch did not recur.

residual_risk: The fresh live run must prove that a rejected candidate's next round remains on the same target and can consume its diagnostic.
The exact r37 target also contains an apparently infeasible generated CMake assertion and an independent delivery-depth residual; neither was modified or hidden by this fix.
